messages.subject: Problem with Annotate
parts:
Dear all,

I have following lines of codes


library(zoo); library(ggplot2)
dat <- zooreg(rnorm(20), start=as.Date("2010-01-01"), frequency=1)
dat1 <- data.frame(value=coredata(dat), date1=as.numeric(index(dat)))
ggplot(dat1) + scale_y_continuous(limits=c(-5, 5)) +
geom_line(aes(y=value, x=date1), size = 1.3,
colour="blueviolet") + xlab(NULL) + ylab(NULL) +
annotate("rect", xmin=c(-Inf), xmax=c(Inf),
ymin=c(-Inf), ymax=c(70),
fill="gray94")

However I get following while running this:

Error in list(x = x, xmin = xmin, xmax = xmax, y = y, ymin = ymin,
ymax = ymax) :
'x' is missing

If somebody point me what is the actual way to draw a rectangle for
above coordinates, I would be grateful.

Thanks,

messages.author: 45a85351148578ad
messages.subject: RE: Problem with Annotate
parts:
Hi Bogaso,

I received no error with your code (sessionInfo() bellow). Instead it
resulted in a plot in which only the line was drawn. This is because of the
limits set in scale_y_continuous. To zoom in you need coord_cartesian(ylim =
c(-5,5)). Curiously, a similar result is obtained if you just change the
value for ymax, e.g. annotate("rect", xmin=c(-Inf), xmax=c(Inf),
ymin=c(-Inf), ymax = c(Inf), fill="gray94").

Hope this helps,
fernando
